final: SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, '(missing)') AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '(missing)')
